lines.text: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded, and he went out to meet Asa.
Asa took courage and removed the idols from Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim's hill country, then restored the altar of the LORD.
They gathered in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year and sacrificed seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from the plunder.
They made a covenant to seek the LORD with all their heart and soul, and whoever would not seek Him would be sent out of Judah.

wrong_details.wrong: would be sent out of Judah

lines.text: Asa removed his mother Maacah as queen mother, burned her Asherah pole in the Kidron Valley, and there was no war until the thirty-fifth year.
